data.name: Privacy Statement
data.value: AnduinOS 隐私声明

data.name: Last updated: October 25, 2026
data.value: 最后更新：2026 年 10 月 25 日

data.name: AnduinOS is designed to operate without first-party operating-system telemetry. We do not collect usage statistics, diagnostic reports, or behavioral data from AnduinOS installations through an AnduinOS telemetry service.
data.value: AnduinOS 的设计目标是不包含第一方操作系统遥测机制。我们不会通过 AnduinOS 遥测服务，从 AnduinOS 安装实例中收集使用统计信息、诊断报告或用户行为数据。

data.name: Some system features and third-party applications require network access. We keep website access logs for security and reliability, and our infrastructure providers process connection metadata when delivering our services. This statement explains these activities and their scope.
data.value:
部分系统功能和第三方应用程序需要访问网络。我们会出于安全性和可靠性的考虑保留网站访问日志，而我们的基础设施服务提供商在交付服务时也会处理网络连接元数据。
本声明将解释这些活动及其适用范围。

data.name: 1. Scope and Data Controller
data.value: 1. 适用范围与数据控制者

data.name: AnduinOS is a Linux distribution based on Ubuntu, maintained by AIURSOFT LIMITED, a company based in Hong Kong. In this statement, 'we', 'us', and 'our' refer to AIURSOFT LIMITED, the controller responsible for the personal data we process through the services described below.
data.value:
AnduinOS 是一个基于 Ubuntu 的 Linux 发行版，由位于香港的 AIURSOFT LIMITED 公司维护。
在本声明中，“我们”均指 AIURSOFT LIMITED。对于下文所述服务中由我们处理的个人数据，AIURSOFT LIMITED 是负责相关数据处理的数据控制者。

data.name: This statement covers AnduinOS, our official website and its redirects, our documentation and news websites, and our package and image download services. Section 4 distinguishes website visits from software downloads. Third-party applications, repositories, mirrors, and community platforms have their own privacy practices.
data.value:
本声明适用于 AnduinOS、我们的官方网站及其重定向服务、文档和新闻网站，以及软件包和系统镜像下载服务。
第 4 节将区分网站访问和软件下载活动。
第三方应用程序、软件仓库、镜像站以及社区平台拥有各自独立的隐私保护实践。

data.name: For privacy questions or requests concerning your personal data, contact us at:
data.value: 如果您对隐私问题有疑问，或希望提出与个人数据有关的请求，请通过以下方式联系我们：

data.name: 2. Operating System Telemetry
data.value: 2. 操作系统遥测

data.name: AnduinOS does not include first-party operating-system telemetry that reports user activity, diagnostics, or usage statistics to AIURSOFT LIMITED.
data.value: AnduinOS 不包含向 AIURSOFT LIMITED 报告用户活动、诊断信息或使用统计数据的第一方操作系统遥测机制。

data.name: Your files, settings, and local system logs are stored on your device as part of normal operation. This local storage does not mean that those records are sent to us. If you choose to send us a bug report, support request, or other information, we receive what you submit.
data.value:
作为正常系统运行的一部分，您的文件、设置以及本地系统日志会存储在您自己的设备上。
这些数据在本地存储，并不意味着它们会被发送给我们。
如果您主动向我们提交错误报告、技术支持请求或其他信息，我们将收到您选择提交的内容。

data.name: AnduinOS follows a local-first design, but it is not an offline-only system. Updates, network services, and applications can communicate with external servers. Their behavior depends on the installed software, its settings, and the features you use.
data.value:
AnduinOS 遵循本地优先的设计理念，但它并不是一个只能离线运行的系统。
软件更新、网络服务和应用程序都可能与外部服务器通信。这些通信的具体行为取决于已安装的软件、软件设置以及您选择使用的功能。

data.name: 3. Network Communications and Third-Party Software
data.value: 3. 网络通信与第三方软件

data.name: Updates and Other Network Features
data.value: 软件更新及其他网络功能

data.name: Software repositories and mirrors receive your IP address and request metadata when your device connects to them. Features such as software updates, time synchronization, connectivity checks, firmware updates, web browsing, and online accounts may require network access, depending on the software and configuration. Some connections can occur automatically in the background.
data.value:
当您的设备连接到软件仓库或镜像站时，这些服务器会收到您的 IP 地址和请求元数据。
根据所安装的软件及其配置，以下功能可能需要网络连接：
软件更新
时间同步
网络连通性检测
固件更新
网页浏览
在线账户
其中部分网络连接可能在后台自动发生。

data.name: AnduinOS builds upon software from Ubuntu, Debian, GNOME, and other projects. Upstream components may be configured, patched, or packaged differently for AnduinOS. Third-party applications and services may have their own reporting or diagnostic features, settings, and consent requirements.
data.value:
AnduinOS 基于 Ubuntu、Debian、GNOME 及其他项目的软件构建。
为了适配 AnduinOS，我们可能对上游组件采用不同的配置、进行补丁修改或重新打包。
第三方应用程序和服务可能具有各自独立的数据上报或诊断功能，以及相应的设置和用户同意要求。

data.name: Installing a package does not necessarily enable reporting. Whether a reporting feature operates depends on its configuration and any applicable consent requirements. Consult the relevant provider's privacy information, including:
data.value:
安装某个软件包并不一定会启用数据上报功能。某项数据上报功能是否运行，取决于其配置以及适用的用户同意要求。
请查阅相关服务提供商的隐私信息，包括：

data.name: Canonical's privacy information
data.value: Canonical 隐私信息

data.name: SimpleWeather
data.value: SimpleWeather

data.name: The SimpleWeather desktop extension is disabled by default in AnduinOS. If you enable weather features, they may contact third-party services for IP-based geolocation, location search, and weather forecasts. Providers receive the IP address used to connect and the information needed for the request, such as a location query or coordinates.
data.value:
AnduinOS 默认禁用 SimpleWeather 桌面扩展。
如果您启用天气功能，该扩展可能连接第三方服务，以获取基于 IP 地址的地理位置信息、搜索地点以及查询天气预报。
这些服务提供商会收到建立网络连接所使用的 IP 地址，以及完成请求所需的信息，例如地点搜索内容或地理坐标。

data.name: The providers and requests depend on the extension version, the AnduinOS configuration, and your settings. Review the available providers and location settings in the extension's preferences, together with the providers' privacy policies. The upstream source and our packaging are available for inspection:
data.value:
实际使用的服务提供商和网络请求取决于扩展版本、AnduinOS 的配置以及您的个人设置。
您可以在扩展的首选项设置中查看可用的服务提供商和位置设置，并查阅这些服务提供商各自的隐私政策。
您还可以独立检查上游源代码以及我们的软件包构建实现：

data.name: SimpleWeather source code
data.value: SimpleWeather 源代码

data.name: AnduinOS SimpleWeather packaging
data.value: AnduinOS SimpleWeather 打包代码

data.name: 4. Website and Download Services
data.value: 4. 网站与下载服务

data.name: Website Access Logs
data.value: 网站访问日志

data.name: When you browse our website, we keep access logs to maintain its security and reliability. This includes our main website, its redirect, documentation, and news:
data.value:
当您浏览我们的网站时，我们会保留访问日志，以维护网站的安全性与可靠性。
这包括我们的主网站、重定向服务、文档网站和新闻网站：

data.name: These logs include IP addresses, request timestamps, requested URLs, browser information, response status, response sizes, and processing times. We use them for service monitoring, automated alerts, attack detection and defense, troubleshooting, and performance diagnosis.
data.value:
这些日志包括以下信息：
IP 地址
请求时间戳
请求的 URL
浏览器信息
HTTP 响应状态码
响应大小
请求处理时间
我们将这些信息用于服务监控、自动告警、攻击检测与防御、故障排查以及性能问题诊断。

data.name: We also use website access logs to produce aggregate traffic statistics, such as page views and estimates based on unique IP addresses, and use aggregated CDN metrics to understand download traffic and bandwidth usage.
data.value:
我们还会使用网站访问日志生成汇总流量统计数据，例如页面浏览量以及根据独立 IP 地址估算的访问数量。
此外，我们还会使用汇总后的 CDN 指标，了解下载流量和带宽使用情况。

data.name: These records describe requests to our websites. They do not give us access to your files or report your activity elsewhere on your computer. Ordinary use of AnduinOS does not send us operating-system telemetry.
data.value:
这些记录描述的是您向我们网站发出的请求。
它们不会让我们访问您计算机上的文件，也不会报告您在计算机其他位置进行的活动。
正常使用 AnduinOS 不会向我们发送操作系统遥测数据。

data.name: Cookies and Account Information
data.value: Cookie 与账户信息

data.name: Our websites and online services, including our main website, documentation, and news services, use cookies to support authentication, security, and user preferences. Language and theme preferences may be stored in cookies for up to one year. Authentication cookies are used to maintain login sessions and protect user accounts.
data.value:
我们的网站和在线服务，包括主网站、文档网站和新闻服务，会使用 Cookie 来支持身份验证、安全保护以及用户偏好设置。
语言和主题偏好可能通过 Cookie 保存，保存期限最长为一年。
身份验证 Cookie 用于维持用户登录会话，并保护用户账户安全。

data.name: Where account features are available, we process information such as usernames, email addresses, display names, and account identifiers to provide authentication and account management. If you choose to sign in through an identity provider, we may receive additional account information from that provider as part of the authentication process.
data.value:
对于提供账户功能的服务，我们会处理以下信息，以实现身份验证和账户管理：
用户名
电子邮件地址
显示名称
账户标识符
如果您选择通过身份提供商登录，我们可能在身份验证过程中从该提供商接收其他账户信息。

data.name: Our account-enabled websites and online services use a shared identity provider to support single sign-on. When you sign in to these services, the identity provider and the service you access may exchange the account identifiers and authentication information necessary to establish and maintain your session. This information is used for authentication and account management, not for operating-system telemetry.
data.value:
我们支持账户功能的网站和在线服务使用共享的身份提供商，实现单点登录。
当您登录这些服务时，身份提供商与您正在访问的服务之间可能交换建立和维持登录会话所必需的账户标识符及身份验证信息。
这些信息仅用于身份验证和账户管理，而不用于操作系统遥测。

data.name: Account information is retained for as long as necessary to provide account services and comply with applicable legal obligations, subject to applicable deletion requirements. Authentication sessions and preference cookies have their own expiration periods. These records are separate from website access logs and are not subject to the 120-day website log retention period.
data.value:
我们将在提供账户服务及履行适用法律义务所必需的期限内保留账户信息，并遵守适用的数据删除要求。
身份验证会话和用户偏好 Cookie 分别具有各自的有效期限。
这些账户记录与网站访问日志相互独立，不适用网站访问日志的 120 天保留期限。

data.name: You can manage or delete cookies through your browser settings, although doing so may sign you out or reset your preferences. For questions about your account information or requests to access or delete personal data, contact us using the details in Section 8.
data.value:
您可以通过浏览器设置管理或删除 Cookie，但这样做可能会导致您退出登录，或者重置个人偏好设置。
如果您对账户信息有疑问，或希望请求访问或删除个人数据，请使用第 8 节提供的联系方式与我们联系。

data.name: Package Updates and Image Downloads
data.value: 软件包更新与系统镜像下载

data.name: Running apt update or apt upgrade does not send us telemetry or reports about how you use your computer. We do not retain HTTP access logs on the package origin servers behind packages.anduinos.com. This describes our origin servers; it does not mean that no connection information is processed along the delivery path.
data.value:
运行 apt update 或 apt upgrade 不会向我们发送遥测数据，也不会报告您如何使用计算机。
我们不会在 packages.anduinos.com 背后的软件包源站服务器上保留 HTTP 访问日志。
这一说明仅适用于我们自己的源站服务器，并不意味着整个内容分发链路中没有任何连接信息被处理。

data.name: Operating-system images are delivered through cf.anduinos.com using Cloudflare's storage and delivery services. Downloading an image or a package requires a network connection, and the providers handling that request receive connection metadata. Visiting a download page on our website is subject to the website logging described above.
data.value:
操作系统镜像通过 cf.anduinos.com 分发，使用 Cloudflare 提供的存储和内容分发服务。
下载系统镜像或软件包需要建立网络连接，处理这些请求的服务提供商会收到相应的网络连接元数据。
如果您访问我们网站上的下载页面，则适用前文所述的网站访问日志政策。

data.name: Service Providers and International Processing
data.value: 服务提供商与国际数据处理

data.name: Cloudflare helps deliver and protect our websites, package downloads, and image downloads. It processes IP addresses and request metadata when providing those services. We also use Vultr for hosting. Our personnel responsible for operating and securing these services use the website logs for the purposes described above.
data.value:
Cloudflare 协助我们分发和保护网站、软件包下载以及系统镜像下载服务。
Cloudflare 在提供这些服务时会处理 IP 地址和请求元数据。
我们还使用 Vultr 提供托管服务。
负责运营和保护这些服务的工作人员，会出于前文所述的目的使用网站访问日志。

data.name: Our company is based in Hong Kong and our providers operate internationally. Personal data processed through these services, including connection metadata, account information, and correspondence, may be processed outside your country, including outside the European Economic Area or the United Kingdom. Cloudflare describes its international processing and transfer safeguards, including standard contractual clauses where applicable, in its privacy policy and Data Processing Addendum. You can contact us for information about the transfers relevant to your data.
data.value:
我们的公司位于香港，而我们的服务提供商在全球多个地区开展业务。
因此，通过这些服务处理的个人数据，包括网络连接元数据、账户信息和通信记录，可能会在您所在国家或地区以外被处理，包括欧洲经济区或英国以外的地区。
Cloudflare 在其隐私政策和数据处理附录中说明了国际数据处理及跨境传输保障措施，包括在适用情况下使用标准合同条款。
您可以联系我们，了解与您的个人数据相关的跨境传输情况。

data.value: Cloudflare 隐私政策

data.value: Vultr 隐私政策

data.name: 5. Data Retention and Your Rights
data.value: 5. 数据保留与您的权利

data.name: Retention and Legal Basis
data.value: 数据保留期限与法律依据

data.name: We retain the website access logs described in Section 4 for up to 120 days.
data.value: 我们对第 4 节所述网站访问日志的保留期限最长为 120 天。

data.name: This period supports investigation of security incidents, recurring attacks, service errors, and performance problems. It describes the website logs we retain; it is not a statement of every independent provider's retention practices.
data.value:
这一期限用于支持安全事件调查、持续性攻击分析、服务故障排查以及性能问题诊断。
该期限仅适用于我们自己保留的网站日志，并不代表所有独立服务提供商都采用相同的数据保留政策。

data.name: Where the EU or UK GDPR applies, the legal basis for this logging is our legitimate interest in keeping our services secure and reliable, preventing abuse, investigating incidents, understanding website and download traffic, and planning service capacity, under Article 6(1)(f). This basis requires consideration of your interests, rights, and freedoms.
data.value:
在欧盟或英国《通用数据保护条例》（GDPR）适用的情况下，我们处理这些日志的法律依据是 GDPR 第 6 条第 1 款第 f 项规定的正当利益。
这些正当利益包括：
维护服务的安全性与可靠性
防止服务遭到滥用
调查安全事件
了解网站访问与下载流量
规划服务容量
采用这一法律依据时，我们需要考虑您的利益、权利和自由。

data.name: Where the EU or UK GDPR applies, we process account and authentication information on the basis of our legitimate interests in providing and securing the online services you choose to use and managing user accounts, under Article 6(1)(f). We rely on our legitimate interests in responding to enquiries and providing support when processing information you submit for those purposes. These interests must be balanced against your interests, rights, and freedoms. Where processing is necessary to comply with an applicable legal obligation, we rely on Article 6(1)(c).
data.value:
在欧盟或英国 GDPR 适用的情况下，我们依据第 6 条第 1 款第 f 项规定的正当利益，处理账户和身份验证信息，以便提供和保护您选择使用的在线服务，并管理用户账户。
当我们处理您主动提交的信息，以回复咨询或提供技术支持时，我们同样依据相应的正当利益。
这些利益必须与您的利益、权利和自由进行权衡。
如果某项数据处理是为了履行适用的法律义务，我们将依据 GDPR 第 6 条第 1 款第 c 项进行处理。

data.name: If you contact us, we use the information you provide to address your enquiry or request. We retain that correspondence for as long as needed to handle the matter and meet applicable legal obligations; the website log retention period does not describe that correspondence.
data.value:
如果您联系我们，我们会使用您提供的信息处理您的咨询或请求。
我们将在处理相关事项以及履行适用法律义务所需的期限内保留这些通信记录。
网站访问日志的保留期限不适用于此类通信记录。

data.name: Your Rights
data.value: 您的权利

data.name: Depending on the law applicable to you and the processing concerned, you may have the right to:
data.value: 根据适用于您及相关数据处理活动的法律，您可能享有以下权利：

data.name: Request information about and access to your personal data, including a copy.
data.value: 知情权与访问权： 请求了解我们处理的个人数据，并获取相关数据的副本。

data.name: Request correction of inaccurate data, deletion, or restriction of processing.
data.value: 更正、删除与限制处理权： 请求更正不准确的个人数据、删除个人数据，或限制对个人数据的处理。

data.name: Object to processing based on legitimate interests on grounds relating to your situation.
data.value: 反对权： 基于与您个人情况相关的理由，反对我们依据正当利益进行的数据处理。

data.name: Receive portable data where the legal conditions for portability are met.
data.value: 数据可携带权： 在符合法律规定条件的情况下，以可携带的形式获取个人数据。

data.name: Complain to the relevant data protection authority, including, where the GDPR applies, the authority in your place of habitual residence, work, or the alleged infringement.
data.value: 投诉权： 向相关数据保护监管机构提出投诉。在 GDPR 适用的情况下，包括您惯常居住地、工作所在地或涉嫌违法行为发生地的数据保护监管机构。

data.name: These rights are subject to the conditions and exceptions in applicable law. To exercise them, email leadership@aiursoft.com. Please identify the service and, for a website log request, the approximate time of your visit. We may need further information to locate the relevant records and verify the request while protecting other people's data. We will respond within the time limits required by applicable law.
data.value:
上述权利受到适用法律规定的条件和例外限制。
如果您希望行使这些权利，请发送电子邮件至：
leadership@aiursoft.com
请说明您的请求涉及哪项服务。
如果您的请求涉及网站访问日志，请尽可能提供大致访问时间。
为了定位相关记录、核实请求并保护其他人的数据，我们可能需要您提供进一步的信息。
我们将在适用法律规定的期限内回复您的请求。

data.name: 6. Open Source and Verifiable Build Policies
data.value: 6. 开源与可验证的构建政策

data.name: Licensing and Source Code
data.value: 软件许可与源代码

data.name: The AnduinOS build and package-maintenance repositories publish our code under GPLv3, except where a different license is stated. Third-party components retain their respective licenses. Including them in the distribution does not place the entire operating system under one license; permissions to use, modify, and redistribute each component follow its applicable terms.
data.value:
AnduinOS 的系统构建仓库和软件包维护仓库以 GPLv3 许可证公开我们的代码，另有明确许可证声明的部分除外。
第三方组件保留各自原有的许可证。
将这些组件包含在发行版中，并不意味着整个操作系统都统一采用同一种许可证。
使用、修改和再分发各个组件的权限，应遵循对应组件所适用的许可证条款。

data.name: Public source code allows independent review of our implementation and privacy-related claims. Its availability does not by itself establish that every component or released binary has undergone a complete privacy audit.
data.value:
公开源代码使任何人都能够独立审查我们的实现及隐私相关声明。
但源代码公开本身并不意味着所有组件或已发布的二进制文件都经过了完整的隐私审计。

data.name: Build Checks and Their Scope
data.value: 构建检查及其适用范围

data.name: Our automated image tests check the installed package database in the live environment and the installed system against a maintained list of prohibited packages and package-name patterns. The check fails if a prohibited package is present. The list includes selected reporting and background-service packages, such as ubuntu-report, popularity-contest, apport, whoopsie, snapd, and Ubuntu Pro components.
data.value:
